housing.summary: Numbeo's June 2026 Brugge table reports EUR 825.00 for a one-bedroom apartment in the city centre, last updated 19 June 2026 (https://www.numbeo.com/cost-of-living/in/Brugge). The Vlaams Woninghuurdecreet of 9 November 2018 caps the rental guarantee for dwellings in the Flemish Region (which includes Bruges) at a maximum of three months' rent, in force since 1 January 2019 (https://codex.vlaanderen.be/PrintDocument.ashx?id=1029963&datum=&geannoteerd=false&print=false). Immoweb has a dedicated Bruges (postcode 8000) apartment-rental search (https://www.immoweb.be/en/search/apartment/for-rent/bruges/8000).

banking.summary: KBC allows applicants without Belgian citizenship or a permanent Belgian address to apply online from abroad; after arrival, they must visit a branch with an ID card and residence permit to sign for and collect the debit card.

schools.summary: The official City of Bruges schools directory lists Dutch-medium nursery, primary, secondary, higher and adult-education categories with enrolment resources for the 2026-2027 school year, and identifies no international-curriculum (IB, British or American) school in Bruges (https://www.brugge.be/onderwijs-en-kinderopvang/brugse-scholen).

legal_admin.summary: A non-Belgian moving from abroad to Bruges must register with the municipality by appointment at Huis van de Bruggeling; after documents are accepted, a neighbourhood inspector verifies the residence before the file proceeds.
legal_admin.registration_step: Make an appointment at Huis van de Bruggeling, attend with the required documents, and complete municipal registration and the residence check.

tax_finance.summary: For Belgian individuals, the tax identification number is the 11-digit National Number attributed when a person is registered in the National Register (source: https://www.oecd.org/content/dam/oecd/en/topics/policy-issue-focus/aeoi/belgium-tin.pdf). A resident cannot apply for a National registration number separately and receives it upon entry in the Belgian population registers (source: https://sigedis.be/en/our-digital-services/citizens/my-identity/my-identification-number). Flanders directs newcomers to register with their municipality to arrange the number, and Bruges provides the local registration procedure (sources: https://www.vlaanderen.be/en/your-future-in-flanders/need-to-know-before-coming-to-belgium and https://www.brugge.be/burgerzaken/niet-belgen/aankomst-brugge/inschrijving-niet-belg).

transport.summary: De Lijn operates Bruges city-centre bus service (source: https://www.delijn.be/en/nieuws/brugge-p-r-gratis-tickets/); its official adult Omnipas for ages 25 to 64 costs EUR 62 for one month, plus a EUR 10 MOBIB administrative fee (source: https://www.delijn.be/en/content/vervoerbewijzen/tarieven/).
transport.driving_licence_exchange: A recognised, valid non-European national licence issued before Belgian registration may be exchanged after at least 185 days of registration; it may be used during the first 185 days, after which a Belgian or European licence is required. Non-exchangeable licences require passing theory and practical tests (source: https://www.brugge.be/burgerzaken/rijbewijzen/buitenlands-rijbewijs-omwisselen).
transport.healthcare_registration: Join an accredited health-insurance fund; those who do not want to join one may join the public Auxiliary Illness and Disability Insurance Fund for free (source: https://www.vlaanderen.be/en/care-and-family/health-insurance).
